question: Should OpenClaw accept a thirdParty-only AccessibilityService foundation in the Android app before the later gateway and agent-policy design is reviewed?
rationale: This is a new high-sensitivity Android capability whose future remote exposure, store-distribution boundary, and operator policy cannot be settled by code review alone.

options.title: Accept the staged thirdParty foundation
options.body: Allow this local-only slice after Android owners verify Play artifact exclusion and the supplied emulator proof, with remote wiring remaining blocked on separate policy review.

options.title: Require the complete policy design first
options.body: Pause this slice until the node.invoke and agent-tool authorization model can be reviewed as one end-to-end capability.

options.title: Keep it external to the app
options.body: Decline bundling the executor and pursue experimentation in an external Android integration instead.

recommendation.title: Accept the staged thirdParty foundation
recommendation.body: Allow this local-only slice after Android owners verify Play artifact exclusion and the supplied emulator proof, with remote wiring remaining blocked on separate policy review.

likelyOwner.reason: The available record identifies steipete as the feature author and only direct routing signal for the staged Android design.
